title: Why was your credit card replacement request rejected
summary: Explains why a credit card replacement request is rejected: (1) an existing replacement request is still pending/processing, or (2) the customer exceeded the 60-day replacement limit by card tier (Entry: 2, Mid: 3, Premium+: 4). Advises contacting support for manual review if a legitimate need exists beyond limits.
faqs: Why was my credit card replacement request rejected?
Can I submit another replacement request if one is still being processed?
What are the 60-day replacement limits for Entry-, Mid-, and Premium-tier cards?
How many replacements per 60-day period are allowed for my card tier?
If I need an extra replacement beyond the limit, what should I do?
